description:
Create a free PropertyList buyer account for a person, or let them log in to the one they have, by
email. PropertyList emails them a link; opening it creates the account (or logs in) with no password.
Never ask for or make up a password. Tell the person to check their email. With an account they can
keep saved homes, saved searches and email alerts on propertylist.es, and see their enquiries. The
email of an estate agent with a PropertyList CRM login cannot be used.

language.description: The person's language, for the email and the account.

name: create_buyer_account
